units: Succ. 51ᵇ שישא כוחלא ומ׳ yellow, black and white marble; B. Bath. 4ᵃ; Yalk. Deut. 913.—Pl. מַרְמָרִין (marmora) marble or cemented pavement.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:6">Targ. Esth. I, 6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:25">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>יתבי בחר ביתא אזלו מ׳</he> sat in a house the pavement (of which) was worn out.
